predecessors.name: British Gold Coast
predecessors.text: the Gold Coast Colony, Ashanti and the Northern Territories: 'On 6 March 1957, the Colony of Gold Coast gained independence as the state of Ghana.'

predecessors.name: British Togoland
predecessors.text: the former Trust Territory of Togoland under British administration, merged with the Gold Coast at independence; 'Volta Region ... includes much of the former mandate's territory'

ledger.x: 1957: the Gold Coast becomes independent as Ghana, the first colony in Sub-Saharan Africa to do so.
1957: British Togoland is united with the new Ghana.
1960: Ghana becomes a republic with Nkrumah as president.

certainty.note: Colonial treaty and survey lines: the Northern Territories boundaries 'were demarcated in 1898 and 1899' against French and German colonies; British Togoland's western edge is the plebiscite line of 1956 (the Volta Region).
